label: Grandstream GWN7801
description: Grandstream GWN7801 - 10-port Layer 2+ managed switch: 8x 10/100/1000BASE-T RJ45 and 2x 1G SFP uplinks, no PoE. 20 Gbps switching capacity, 10 Gbps non-blocking, 14.88 Mpps, 4.1 Mb packet buffer, fanless 300 mm desktop case, managed by web UI, CLI and GDMS Networking / GWN Manager.

fabric.note: Datasheet Switching Capability 20 Gbps, Total non-blocking throughput 10 Gbps, forwarding rate 14.88 Mpps.

notes: Datasheet table: 8 Gigabit Ethernet ports, 2x 1G SFP ports, 1 console, integrated power supply 30 W, 1x reset pinhole, no PoE ports on this SKU. 300 x 175 x 44 mm, 1.8 kg, fanless, desktop/wall/rack mount. RJ45 console at 115200 8-N-1 drops into the CLI (https://documentation.grandstream.com/knowledge-base/grandstream-network-switches-faq/), so cli is declared. Management is web UI, CLI and GDMS Networking / GWN Manager; the datasheet lists HTTPS, SSH and Telnet, so http-server and cli are the modelled capabilities. Layer 2+ only: no static routing is listed for the GWN7801/GWN7802/GWN7803 SKUs, so l3-forward is not declared. Firmware (https://documentation.grandstream.com/knowledge-base/gwn-management-platforms-user-guide/): minimum 1.0.3.19 (1.0.5.52 with GWN Manager), recommended 1.0.5.52.

label: Grandstream GWN7801P
description: Grandstream GWN7801P - 10-port Layer 2+ managed PoE switch: 8x 10/100/1000BASE-T RJ45 (8 PoE+) and 2x 1G SFP uplinks, 802.3af/at, 30 W a port, 130 W total PoE budget from a 150 W supply. 20 Gbps switching capacity, 14.88 Mpps, fanless 300 mm desktop case.

poe.note: Datasheet Max Total PoE Output Power 130 W from a 150 W integrated supply, Max Output Power per PoE Port 30 W, standards IEEE 802.3af/at. 130 W is the ceiling, not 8 ports x 30 W.

fabric.note: Datasheet Switching Capability 20 Gbps, Total non-blocking throughput 10 Gbps, forwarding rate 14.88 Mpps.

notes: Datasheet: 8 Gigabit Ethernet PoE ports, 2x 1G SFP, 1 console, integrated power supply 150 W, 30 W max a port, 802.3af/at only (this series has no 802.3bt). 2 kg. Console 115200 8-N-1 into the CLI. Discrepancy: the GWN7800 series eBrochure (23Q1) and the product-page comparison chart both give 120 W maximum PoE power for the GWN7801P, while the current model datasheet and the GWN780x technical-specification page (https://documentation.grandstream.com/knowledge-base/gwn780x-series-technical-specifications/) both give 130 W from a 150 W supply; the 130 W datasheet figure is what is modelled.

label: Grandstream GWN7806
description: Grandstream GWN7806 - 54-port Layer 2+ managed switch: 48x 10/100/1000BASE-T RJ45 and 6x 10G SFP+ uplinks, no PoE. 216 Gbps switching capacity, 108 Gbps non-blocking, 160.704 Mpps, 16 Mb packet buffer, 32 IPv4 / 32 IPv6 static routes, stackable to 4 units, three fans, 1U 440 mm rack case.

fabric.note: Datasheet Switching Capability 216 Gbps, Total non-blocking throughput 108 Gbps, forwarding rate 160.704 Mpps.

notes: Datasheet: 48 Gigabit Ethernet ports, 6x 10G SFP+ (DAC up to 5 m; supported modules SM-10G 6, MM-10G 6, RJ45-10G 3, inserted into alternating slots), 1 console, integrated power supply 60 W, 3 fans, 440 x 301 x 44 mm, 4.0 kg, 32K MAC addresses, 4K VLANs, 32 VLAN virtual interfaces with 9216 MTU, 1K ARP/NDP, 32 link aggregation groups, 256 ACLs with 4K ACEs, jumbo frames 10240 bytes. Routing is 32 IPv4 / 32 IPv6 static entries plus DHCP server and relay, so dhcp-server is declared while the category stays switch: no dynamic routing protocol is listed. Stacking up to 4 devices with dual-boot hardware (two FLASH chips) and dual system-file redundancy. Console 115200 8-N-1 into the CLI. Discrepancies: the technical-specification page (https://documentation.grandstream.com/knowledge-base/gwn780x-series-technical-specifications/) gives 160.702 Mpps (datasheet 160.704 Mpps) and 27 link aggregation groups (datasheet 32); the GWN7800 series eBrochure calls the six uplinks Gigabit SFP while the model datasheet and product page call them 10G SFP+, and the datasheet wins. Firmware (https://documentation.grandstream.com/knowledge-base/gwn-management-platforms-user-guide/): minimum 1.0.1.14 for GWN7806, recommended 1.0.5.52.

label: Grandstream GWN7806P
description: Grandstream GWN7806P - 54-port Layer 2+ managed PoE switch: 48x 10/100/1000BASE-T RJ45 (48 PoE+) and 6x 10G SFP+ uplinks, 802.3af/at, 30 W a port, 400 W total PoE budget from a 470 W supply. 216 Gbps switching capacity, 160.704 Mpps, three fans, 1U 440 mm rack case.

poe.note: Datasheet Max Total PoE Output Power 400 W from a 470 W integrated supply, Max Output Power per PoE Port 30 W, standards IEEE 802.3af/at. 400 W is the ceiling, not 48 ports x 30 W.

fabric.note: Datasheet Switching Capability 216 Gbps, Total non-blocking throughput 108 Gbps, forwarding rate 160.704 Mpps.

notes: Datasheet: 48 PoE ports at 802.3af/at with 30 W maximum a port (no 802.3bt on this series), 6x 10G SFP+, 1 console, 470 W supply, 400 W PoE budget, 3 fans, 5.1 kg. Static routing 32 IPv4 / 32 IPv6 plus DHCP server and relay. Console 115200 8-N-1 into the CLI. 400 W is the ceiling, so about 13 ports can draw a full 30 W each before the budget binds.
